requirements.req_text: Do ONE of the following: (a) For one day, keep a log in which you describe your communication activities. Keep track of the time and different ways you spend communicating, such as talking person-to-person, listening to teachers, listening to the radio or podcasts, watching television, using social media, reading books and other print media, and using any electronic communication device. Discuss with your counselor what your log reveals about the importance of communication in your life. Think of ways to improve your communication skills. (b) For three days, keep a journal of your listening experiences. Identify one example of each of the following, and discuss with your counselor when you have listened to each: obtain information, be persuaded, appreciate or enjoy something, and understand someone's feelings. (c) In a small-group setting, meet with other Scouts or with friends. Have them share personal stories about significant events in their lives that affected them in some way. Take note of how each Scout participates in the group discussion and how effectively each Scout communicates their story. Report what you have learned to your counselor about the differences you observed in effective communication. (d) List as many ways as you can think of to communicate with others (face-to-face, by telephone, letter, email, text messages, social media, and so on). For each type of communication, discuss with your counselor an instance when that method might not be appropriate or effective.

quiz_item.scenario_prompt: During an interpersonal conversation or troop leadership council meeting for Communication Requirement 1, which behavior demonstrates effective active listening?
quiz_item.question: During an interpersonal conversation or troop leadership council meeting for Communication Requirement 1, which behavior demonstrates effective active listening?
options: A. Interrupting the speaker mid-sentence to offer your own story while checking text messages on your phone.
B. Crossing your arms, looking at the floor, and formulating a rebuttal before the other person finishes speaking.
C. Repeating the exact same loud slogan louder each time an audience member asks a clarifying question.

D. Maintaining appropriate eye contact and open posture, avoiding distractions, waiting until the speaker finishes, and paraphrasing or asking clarifying questions to confirm you understood their message.
choices: A. Interrupting the speaker mid-sentence to offer your own story while checking text messages on your phone.
B. Crossing your arms, looking at the floor, and formulating a rebuttal before the other person finishes speaking.
C. Repeating the exact same loud slogan louder each time an audience member asks a clarifying question.

D. Maintaining appropriate eye contact and open posture, avoiding distractions, waiting until the speaker finishes, and paraphrasing or asking clarifying questions to confirm you understood their message.
quiz_item.correct_answer: D. Maintaining appropriate eye contact and open posture, avoiding distractions, waiting until the speaker finishes, and paraphrasing or asking clarifying questions to confirm you understood their message.
quiz_item.explanation: Correct Answer (D): Active listening involves attentiveness to both verbal content and nonverbal cues, withholding premature judgment, and paraphrasing key points to verify accurate understanding.

patrol_quiz_bank.scenario_prompt: During an interpersonal conversation or troop leadership council meeting for Communication Requirement 1, which behavior demonstrates effective active listening?
patrol_quiz_bank.question: During an interpersonal conversation or troop leadership council meeting for Communication Requirement 1, which behavior demonstrates effective active listening?
options: A. Interrupting the speaker mid-sentence to offer your own story while checking text messages on your phone.
B. Crossing your arms, looking at the floor, and formulating a rebuttal before the other person finishes speaking.
C. Repeating the exact same loud slogan louder each time an audience member asks a clarifying question.

D. Maintaining appropriate eye contact and open posture, avoiding distractions, waiting until the speaker finishes, and paraphrasing or asking clarifying questions to confirm you understood their message.
choices: A. Interrupting the speaker mid-sentence to offer your own story while checking text messages on your phone.
B. Crossing your arms, looking at the floor, and formulating a rebuttal before the other person finishes speaking.
C. Repeating the exact same loud slogan louder each time an audience member asks a clarifying question.

D. Maintaining appropriate eye contact and open posture, avoiding distractions, waiting until the speaker finishes, and paraphrasing or asking clarifying questions to confirm you understood their message.
patrol_quiz_bank.correct_answer: D. Maintaining appropriate eye contact and open posture, avoiding distractions, waiting until the speaker finishes, and paraphrasing or asking clarifying questions to confirm you understood their message.
patrol_quiz_bank.explanation: Correct Answer (D): Active listening involves attentiveness to both verbal content and nonverbal cues, withholding premature judgment, and paraphrasing key points to verify accurate understanding.

B. Criticize the audience for not already owning the product or service
C. Tell a story about how the product or service helped you or someone like your audience

choices: A. Read the entire manufacturing manual aloud from start to finish

patrol_quiz_bank.correct_answer: C. Tell a story about how the product or service helped you or someone like your audience

options: A. Including only the arguments made by the loudest speaker in the room
B. Accurately summarizing all points of view expressed on the issue without bias
C. Leaving out any viewpoint that disagrees with your personal opinion
D. Rewriting the speakers' quotes to make one side sound foolish
choices: A. Including only the arguments made by the loudest speaker in the room
B. Accurately summarizing all points of view expressed on the issue without bias
C. Leaving out any viewpoint that disagrees with your personal opinion
D. Rewriting the speakers' quotes to make one side sound foolish
patrol_quiz_bank.correct_answer: B. Accurately summarizing all points of view expressed on the issue without bias
patrol_quiz_bank.explanation: Correct Answer (B): An objective report requires active listening and careful note-taking so that every point of view presented at the meeting is represented fairly (p. 35).
